description: Two stacked areas normalized so every month fills 100%, showing each series' share rather than its value.
overview: Two stacked areas stretched so every month fills the full height, turning absolute numbers into shares. Pick it over the regular stacked chart when the split between series matters more than the total.
usage: Replace `chartData` and rename the series keys consistently in the data, the areas and `chartConfig`. Every series must share the same `stackId` to be normalized together. The right-hand axis is already formatted as percentages.
notes: The tooltip shows the original values, not percentages; add a tooltip formatter if readers need the share. Focus the plot and use the arrow keys to move the tooltip between months.
